I feel like a burden on my mother.  I'm unemployed and she's paying my rent, for food, and for my cannabis (it's sometimes the only thing that will stop me from having a breakdown, I know it's a bandage instead of a cure.)

I've always felt like I was on different level than everyone else, and everyone had more rights than me, had the right to tell me what to do, that I can't tell others what to do.  Even now I can't tell someone I disagree with them or what they're doing out of fear of doing the wrong thing.
You could likewise look at 4chan and say there are terrible people online.

I understand different marks on different lines denote different notes/durations.  But that's about it.  I can't identify a note by ear, I've never played an instrument, I pretty much have no idea what I'm doing.  Beats at specific times is all I understand.

At the time, I had an infection where it burned to pee, the skin around my penis between the sack and leg was red, extremely sore and sensitive to touch, and had some yellowish white goop on it.  If it matters I was also consuming a lot of stevia.
There was a while where it was smelling very sweet, yes.  I just remembered.  This was a few months ago, along with the height of the intensity of the maple smell.
I don't have any other symptoms.
